source_projection: Only source paths, bytes, physical lines, canonical/installed hashes and patch provenance are consumed; mutable semantic ownership fields are deliberately excluded.
word_navigation_rule: ASCII letters length>=3 and at least one whitespace; on parsed string text or template static parts joined by one space. Navigation only; no English/runtime/translation certainty.

offsets.start_end: UTF16 code units, inclusive start/exclusive end. Line/column 1-based UTF16.
offsets.decoded_text_json: Parser text for ordinary/no-substitution literals; static parsed segment array for templates. No interpolation evaluation; tagged template flags retained.
offsets.regex: Raw pattern and flags source only; no RegExp evaluation.

coverage.current_semantic_owners: See separate pi-ai-runtime-census.csv; no owner is inferred from lexical rows.

interpretation: Lexical navigation only. Function/if/ternary/short-circuit ancestors are syntactic containment, not actual execution guards, caller closure, English, localization candidates or runtime publication. Numeric/boolean/null literals, comments and bare identifiers are outside this text-literal ledger. Literal/template and regex/control ledgers intentionally overlap. Canonical versus exact public patch provenance checked separately for every body in both installed trees. No audited source import or execution.
